description: This file contains authentication-related functions for password hashing, verification, and token extraction from HTTP headers, primarily used in a Flask web application.

methods.name: str _pbkdf2_sha256(password: str, salt: str)
methods.description: Performs salted password hashing using sha256 with pbkdf2_hmac.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str, salt: str)
methods.description: Public method to hash a password with a salt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, salt: str, expected_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies if a password corresponds to an expected hash.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_bearer_token()
methods.description: Extracts a Bearer token from the Authorization header in a Flask request.

ctags.name: verify_password
ctags.pattern: /^def verify_password(password: str, salt: str, expected_hash: str) -> bool:$/
